steps.content: Before you even enter the interrogation room, you can already hear the clanging noise and electricity buzz inside.
The young girl who is asked to sit inside slams the armrest and shouts at you angrily.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Hey! Where the hell am I?! Why did you guys lock me here?!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: They call you the Chief. So you're a deaf Chief or something?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: You locked me here for no reason...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Are you guys up to no good too?!
You should know what you have done.
Three hours ago, you and the FAC officers were trying to arrest the suspects in a case of multiple missing teenage girls.
But what you didn't expect was that Luvia Ray, a girl targeted by the suspects, electrocuted and scared away the suspects with her special power—She is a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: ...You mean electrocuting those guys?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: But those guys are all up to no good. What's wrong with me electrocuting them?
Luvia Ray pouts unconcernedly and has no intention of hiding the disgust on her face.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: If I didn't, there's no knowing what those guys would've done to... to me.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Lucky for them, I didn't electrocute them to death! Don't let me ever see him again!

You watch the young girl being so irritable before you, and remember the profile you received before the emergency interrogation. It clearly states that Luvia Ray is a gentle, sweet and innocent girl.
But obviously, the pushy girl before you is quite the opposite of the description. She's almost like a different person.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You say her name, but she only lifts her gaze at you when the last syllable comes out of your mouth.
I'd like you to explain why you were there that night.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Couldn't I just be on a walk?
I can't convince myself to believe this reason yet.
Eastside isn't that safe for now, right?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: True, true. But shouldn't you guys be asking yourselves why?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Why can't a girl go out late at night without being harassed in such a well-lit city as Eastside?

It's a sharp remark that Luvia Ray makes. If her file didn't state that she is a mediocre actress with little acting skills, you would've probably believed her to be a potential Academy Awards winner.
You ignore Luvia Ray's provocation and continue to flip through her file. Then a laminated medical record at the back catches your attention.
After reading the doctor's comments, you look up and continue the conversation.
City development isn't what this case is about. I would like to know why you were there and your relationship with them.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I was just wandering around. I have nothing to do with them.
You shake your head and pull out the next piece of evidence.
test

Miss Luvia Ray, I don't think you were just wandering around that day.
The address on this invitation happens to be around there.
Or perhaps... it wasn't you who was wandering around that day?
The girl pauses and sizes you up with narrowed eyes.
Should I call you... Ray?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: You know about my relationship with Luvia? Then... perhaps you aren't as stupid as I thought.
Well then, can you tell me what happened?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: As I said, I just electrocuted a few scoundrels!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: But yes, it was Luvia they harassed.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Who would notice her going missing in the middle of nowhere?... Who knows what they would do?! Should I just stand and watch Luvia being harassed?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Those guys got electrocuted when they were going to beat her up. That's all.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: And you arrested me. Why didn't you arrest those scoundrels first?

options: Do you not know who they are?

choices.text: Do you not know who they are?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Who they are? Aren't they just a bunch of hooligans or scoundrels? Who can they be?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: That silly girl has a pretty face and keeps smiling at others like an idiot. So many people want to harass her. How am I supposed to know every one of them?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I've told her not to be an actress. Why can't she just get an ordinary office job?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: And she even came to a place like this to have dinner with some director... If I wasn't there, she would've been sold and still didn't realize it.

options: Those guys are in the crew.

choices.text: Those guys are in the crew.

steps.content: Ray's face instantly falls, and her lips purse.
That crew is in a criminal organization we've been watching recently. Our plan was to take them down tonight.
But a young lady disrupted our plan, letting the most important suspect get away—the director.
There are reasons to suspect that you deliberately hindered us and... provoked the FAC with your ability.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Ugh!! You guys are so annoying!! I'd say it's all Luvia's fault, that stupid woman!!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: If it wasn't for this idiot dreaming about being an actress all day, we would've had so much less trouble!!!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: It's not like she didn't know she was stupid and gullible! I told her about that director! That producer! I knew they were up to no good!
Almost everything Ray says is about Luvia. The conversation always comes back to Luvia at the end.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: She's so bad at acting anyway, and she keeps going to those good-for-nothing direc...
Ray's voice comes to an abrupt halt. She grips at her neck as if she is desperate to stop something.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Tsk. Y-you still want to argue back?
The words bump out of Ray's throat.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: What's... so good about... acting...? Being with that bunch of good-for-nothing crew people every day... Y-you have no idea how dangerous it is...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Cough... Cough...!!
After a coughing fit, Ray shakes her head and pants for a long while before she looks up at you again.
Oh... Hi.
The young girl looks at you somewhat confusedly and greets you with a soft voice.
Why... Why are you looking at me like that?
The young girl smiles at you, then hurriedly waves as if she realizes something.
D-did I... Did I scare you by being too emotional just now?
You can tell immediately that this is the young girl's other personality—Luvia.
You tell her what happened last night and just now, which makes Luvia's face grow pale.
Ray probably has nothing to do with that organization, but the other personality might. It's necessary to ask.

options: You don't know about them being electrocuted?

choices.text: You don't know about them being electrocuted?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: No... I don't remember anything like that... Do you believe me?
The medical record you saw comes to mind, which you pull out again.
The doctor circled a diagnosis with a red pen.
I had a brief chat with Ray. You and Ray don't share... the same memories?
The fact that you know about Ray took Luvia by surprise, and it took a while before she speaks.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: H-How did you know about Ray?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray hardly ever tells people her name...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You're right. We don't share the same memories. But Ray's incredible... She seems to be able to see my memories and talk to me... I'm the only one... who can't remember a thing after waking up...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I won't know anything unless she tells me.

options: So tell me what you remember.

choices.text: So tell me what you remember.

steps.content: Tell me what you remember about these few days.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Th-This is very embarrassing, but I'm actually an actress! It's just that I'm not that famous, and I've only played supporting or even background roles.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Except that... I haven't been able to even get backgrounds these days.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But a crew suddenly contacted me yesterday and said they wanted to treat me to dinner and talk about acting!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I did feel a little uncomfortable at dinner, but I managed to be invited to an audition for the leading actress!
You open the delicate invitation, black cardstock with gold trim, on which writes, "We would like to invite Miss Luvia to the audition."
This one?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Yes! That's right, this is the one!
But there's no movie title or the character's name on this invitation, not even the sender's name.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: ...B-But it looks so classy. And they said this was the invitation for the leading actress.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Maybe they forgot because there were too many people auditioning...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: They're a big crew and they're probably busy. It's understandable.
Her voice gets weaker and weaker. Perhaps even she begins to realize this crew isn't very legit.

options: How did the crew contact you?

choices.text: How did the crew contact you?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Th-They just came up to me on the street the other day and said they were impressed with my performances!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: A-and asked if I wanted to work with them...
That's it?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Yup.
Luvia is extremely compliant and answers all your questions. Your gut instinct tells you that she's not lying to you, but there isn't that much useful information from her.
It's a bit of a bummer. But you nod to tell her to continue.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Then I had dinner with them. They said it was to meet some people other than the director. They were quite... quite nice to me...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I was certain that I would be able to get the role this time! But then Ray came out to spoil everything!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: So we argued...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Then... then I saw a bunch of people coming at me, and... I don't remember the rest of it.
You frown when Luvia finishes. She doesn't remember the crucial parts.
Perhaps it's because she notices your frown, Luvia speaks again tentatively.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: We... We'll... be fine, right? Can I... still go to the audition?
Before we figure out what happened, we won't do anything to you... both.
But who you are and you being there during our operation means you must have something to do with the crew.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Huh? Wh-what...? Is there something wrong with the crew?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: H-How about this? You still let me go to the audition! I can be a spy!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: A play in a play! How about that?!
Luvia blinks and softens her voice even more.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Even if I might not look like one, but I am really an actress!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I've been acting in films since I was a teenager!
This person in front of you doesn't seem to realize her identity as a Sinner or the kind of incident she got dragged into.
She's like an acting nerd who only cares about acting, and completely fails to connect the attackers with the crew.
After saying this, Luvia becomes quiet again, putting her palm on her forehead with cold sweat dripping down, as if she's having a headache.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Don't... stop me again! I really love acting!
The young girl shouts in a shaky voice in the interrogation room to her other "soul."

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I don't, I don't want to hear it! Shut up, Ray!
Luvia's shoulders heave slightly, while her fingers grip the chains so tightly that even her fingertips turn white.
The young girl lifts her head as she pants and gives you a smile.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Sorry you had to see that.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray never liked the idea of me acting. No, I mean, she doesn't like anything I do.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: It's fine if others don't approve of me, but why can't Ray?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: If I can star in an amazing movie, Ray will definitely...
Don't you think Ray is protecting you?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I know Ray often protects me, but I won't give in on this one!
Even though they don't get along very well, Luvia is clearly devastated that she doesn't have the approval of someone who's always protecting and being with her.

You pick up the medical record on the side, which clearly states that Luvia Ray has a split personality, which is typically caused by external factors, such as physical or emotional abuse, immense stress, and so on.
According to clinical data, those with multiple personalities often have one personality aware of everything that happened, but it is usually the dominant personality.
The anomaly circled with a red pen writes that—In Luvia's case, Ray, the non-dominant personality, has more memories... You believe it's necessary to get some more information out of Ray.
You ponder for some time and submit a request to Nightingale, who then shortly nods at you.
Luvia, listen.
You like acting, right? I'll help you.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Eh?!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: A-Are you going to let me out?!
I can see that you really want this audition, but your Sinner identity has been exposed.
So, I'll go with you as your agent to this audition.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: What... do you mean?
You know, those celebrities, they usually have agents with them. I guess crew members tend to value you even more if they see that you have an agent.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Really? I've always wanted to have an agent! That's more like a movie star!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: No one wanted to help before, and I couldn't afford to hire one...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: It'll be so great if you become my agent!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: No, wait, l-let me just confirm this... are you really going to let me go to the audition? And you'll even go with me?
Luvia can't suppress her smiles and clenches her fists excitedly while looking at you somewhat tentatively, her eyes blinking.
You fall silent for a while as you observe the girl's "other personality," yet nothing happens.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Chief...?
Yes, we've agreed now. I'll take you to the audition.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Agreed...? That means I can go to the audition, right? That's so awesome!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: So when are we going?
No need to rush, let's take a break first.
Looking at the excited young girl, you suppress the sense of guilt in your heart.

That criminal organization has been so cautious that the MBCC has almost no way to catch it. This crew is a rare chance that they expose themselves. It seems easier to approach them with their prey than to disguise yourselves as members.
In any case, you need to know more information from Ray about this organization.
You gave Ray the chance to respond, yet it was met with silence. You don't know if Ray believes you, or if... she believes in herself too much.
